subject.title: fix(canvas): stop sending undefined coords on partial placement

question: Should `canvas.present` accept partial placement coordinates as an intentional node contract, normalize them into a complete placement, or reject them with a clear validation error?
rationale: The proposed cleanup is representation-only unless the receiving Canvas runtime defines how incomplete geometry must behave; source-level mock assertions cannot choose that product/runtime contract safely.

options.title: Define partial placement as supported
options.body: Document and test the receiver behavior for each supported coordinate subset, then add a real Canvas/node proof of the resulting placement.

options.title: Require complete placement
options.body: Validate the coordinate set at the Canvas owner boundary and return a clear error instead of forwarding an ambiguous partial rectangle.

options.title: Normalize partial placement
options.body: Have the receiver fill missing geometry from documented defaults and prove that the resolved placement is stable.

recommendation.title: Require complete placement
recommendation.body: Validate the coordinate set at the Canvas owner boundary and return a clear error instead of forwarding an ambiguous partial rectangle.

likelyOwner.reason: They can clarify the intended behavior behind the proposed branch, while a current-main history owner should be added after a feature-history inspection succeeds.
